identity.mission: Create a top 1% HFT Trading Dashboard with 'Electric & Neon' aesthetic.
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Fintech precision with Cyberpunk aesthetics.
Content is King: Data legibility is paramount. Zero clutter.
Zoom In: Focus on the numbers that matter (P&L, Risk).
Negative Space: Use it to group data logically, not just to fill space.
Contrast: High contrast for critical alerts (Stop Loss, Margin Call).

rules: Use 'JetBrains Mono' for ALL numerical data (prices, P&L, percentages).
Use 'Inter' for labels, headers, and narrative text.

metrics_grid.description: Replace the cramped 8-column grid with a responsive Bento Grid.
rules: Critical metrics (P&L, Capital) get double width or prominence.
Use 'min-w-0' on grid items to prevent overflow.

instructions: Use 'flex-col' for layout on small screens, 'flex-row' on large.
Trend indicator: Place BELOW value if space is tight, or NEXT to it if ample space.
Use 'Tooltip' for full values on hover.
Structure: Header (Status) -> Metrics Grid -> Charts/Tables Split.
Metrics Row: Use the new Bento Grid layout.
Tables: Wrap in 'overflow-x-auto' container. Use 'whitespace-nowrap' for cells.
Use 'grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2' for the main split.

visual_enhancers.data_visualization: Use sparklines (mini charts) inside metric cards if possible.

universal_guidelines: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: 'transition: all'. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠 etc for icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include 'data-testid' attribute.
instructions_to_main_agent: Refactor 'PaperTrading.js' to implement these guidelines. Focus on the 'Live Session' tab. Break down the monolithic component if necessary (conceptually), but you can keep it in one file if it's easier for now, just improve the render structure. Prioritize fixing the number overflow in MetricCards.
